I'll write Python code to calculate the sum of the decimal digits of 64!

```python
import math

# Calculate 64!
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)

# Convert to string and sum the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(factorial_64))

# Output only the numerical answer
print(digit_sum)
```
